item.title: OpenClaw Releases 2.0 Update
item.description:
OpenClaw Releases 2.0 Update

OpenClaw has released OpenClaw 2.0, which is described as the largest update in the history of the project.

⚙️ Key details

The update was built by 933 contributors and includes the following:

  • A simplified installation process
  • A rebuilt browser app

#OpenClaw #OpenSource #SoftwareUpdate

Source: Techmeme
